codeReview.summary: The sidepanel listener cleanup is wired correctly, but the content-script half of the fix is incomplete: although content.ts now stores the runtime listener and exposes destroy(), nothing ever calls that cleanup method, so the runtime listener is not actually removed during the content script lifecycle.

issues.description: ContentScriptHandler.destroy() removes the stored runtime listener, but there is no lifecycle hook or call site that ever invokes destroy(). The file still ends with `new ContentScriptHandler();` and contains no unload/pagehide cleanup path, so the listener reference is never actually removed, which does not fulfill VAL-CRIT-003's requirement that content-script runtime listeners be properly removed.
